name: coreav
description: Media probing and stream copy (probe, check, clip, remux, sanitize, split, extract audio, subtitles and chapters) for MP4, MOV, Matroska and WebM: the coreav command, native on Linux and macOS, WebAssembly elsewhere

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const f of ['wasm/coreav.wasm', 'LICENSE-MIT', 'LICENSE-APACHE']) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) { console.error('run scripts/build.sh first: ' + f + ' is missing'); process.exit(1); } if (fs.readFileSync('bin/coreav').subarray(0, 2).toString() !== '#!') { console.error('bin/coreav is not the launcher; restore it (git checkout bin/coreav)'); process.exit(1); }"
